# PngSuite fixtures

These binary PNG files are vendored as deterministic decoder acceptance fixtures.

Source: `pnggroup/libpng`, `contrib/pngsuite/`.

The upstream PngSuite README grants permission to use, copy, modify, and distribute the images for any purpose and without fee.

Current fixtures:

- `basn0g16.png` — 16-bit grayscale
- `basn2c16.png` — 16-bit truecolor
- `basn4a16.png` — 16-bit grayscale + alpha
- `basn6a16.png` — 16-bit RGBA

The fixtures are not generated by rustmpeg. They are independent upstream conformance inputs. Their IHDR bit depth and color type are asserted in the test suite to catch accidental fixture replacement.
